[
  "When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1-3mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as lesions on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions and on the genitalia.",
  "The consensus rate for the recommendation is 100% (21 out of 21 experts).",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first-line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness, as well as for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins should be based on tumor thickness.",
  "The criteria driving the 7-point score are vascular structures (dotted vessels, 2 points) and pigmentation (diffuse irregular, 1 point).",
  "These criteria are major and minor respectively and contribute to a total score of 3.",
  "On the image, look for dotted or linear-irregular vessels, which represent vascular structures.",
  "On the image, look for diffuse irregular pigmentation, which represents pigmentation.",
  "The presence of these features is sufficient to trigger the 7-point score threshold even if the classifier interprets the image as benign."
]
